description: Sign in to SPV now. Rarely needed: every tool signs in by itself when the session is missing or has ended. The server reads the password from its credential source, SPV e-mails a security code, and the mail driver reads it from the mailbox; the answer says signed_in. When no mail driver can read it (manual, or the code did not come in time) the answer says awaiting_code with a deadline: read the newest "Cod de siguranta" mail from Autentificare.SpatiuPrivat@anaf.ro and pass its digits to complete_login. Each sign-in e-mails the user a code.

code_by_hand.description: Do not read the code from the mailbox: stop at awaiting_code and wait for complete_login.

force.description: Sign in again even when the stored session still works.

name: login
title: Sign in
